[SWS_DM_01264] DiagnosticAging.threshold reached
⌈
The Diag-
nosticAging.threshold defines the number of Aging cycles until Aging. If the
threshold is reached, the event memory entry shall be deleted (aged) from the event
memory including the snapshot records and extended data records belong-
ing to that aged DTC.
⌋
